description: WebRTC calls (protocol section 4.11). 'valid': one of each frame; 'invalid': frames that MUST draw the error shown. 'candidates': ICE candidates and whether a side may send or take them. 'sdp': an SDP as written, and as sent or taken, its candidates outside the tailnet removed. 'offers': the call capabilities of a caller's and a callee's hellos, and the transports the caller's offer lists.
